title: Sell Mineral Rights in Ray, ND
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Ray, ND
metaDescription: Own mineral rights near Ray, ND in Williams County? This area has both Bakken and older Tyler formation history. Get a straight offer.
heroLead: Ray sits in Williams County ground that's been producing oil longer than most people realize, with older Tyler formation wells sitting alongside the newer Bakken horizontal development.
intro: Families around Ray who've held mineral rights since the original homestead sometimes have two layers of production history to sort through: an older conventional lease from decades back, and a more recent Bakken-era lease on the same tract. We untangle which one actually applies to your interest before we say anything about value.

sections.heading: Two eras of drilling on the same ground
paragraphs: The Tyler formation saw conventional development in this part of Williams County well before the Bakken horizontal boom, and some Ray-area tracts still have both types of wells on record. We check the full well history for your specific legal description so nothing about your interest surprises us partway through a sale.

sections.heading: What a Ray-area royalty statement usually shows
paragraphs: If your family has both an older conventional royalty and a newer Bakken royalty on the same or nearby tracts, it's common to see two separate statements with very different production patterns. We can review both and explain what each one means for your interest's current value.

sections.heading: Homestead families still holding Ray-area ground
paragraphs: A lot of the mineral interests around Ray trace back to farm families who homesteaded this stretch of Williams County generations ago, some of whom still ranch the surface today while others sold the land but kept the minerals. Either way, ownership is often split among several heirs by now.
We confirm the current chain of title through the Williams County Recorder before we make an offer, so any number reflects exactly what you hold today.

faqs.question: We have paperwork mentioning a well from decades ago. Does that still matter?
faqs.answer: It can. Older Tyler formation leases sometimes remain relevant to current ownership. We check the full history before making an offer.

faqs.question: Do you buy both conventional and Bakken interests near Ray?
faqs.answer: Yes, we evaluate both types of production and can make an offer on either or both if you hold interests in each.

faqs.question: How do we tell which well our royalty check is actually from?
faqs.answer: Send us the statement and we'll match it against the state's well records to identify the specific well and formation.

faqs.question: Several relatives inherited shares of the same Ray-area tract. Can we sell separately?
faqs.answer: Yes, each owner can sell their individual share, or we can coordinate a single transaction covering everyone if that's easier for your family.
